camel_example: aliyun tdsr PredImage --region cn-hangzhou --DetectDoor true --SubSceneId 23450000 --CorrectVertical true --version 2020-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Preprocesses images, including vertical correction, wall line prediction, and door prediction. You can call this operation to retry when automatic door prediction or image slicing fails
description_zh: 图片预处理，包括垂直矫正、墙线预测、门预测，自动门预测与切图失败时可使用此接口发起重试
kebab_example: aliyun tdsr pred-image --sub-scene-id 23450000 --detect-door true --correct-vertical true --region cn-hangzhou
name: PredImage

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform vertical correction
parameters.name: correct_vertical

schema.description_en: The response information, which includes the request ID, whether the call is successful, and other result fields
schema.description_zh: 接口返回信息，包含请求 ID、调用是否成功以及其他结果字段

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authorization diagnosis details returned when permission verification fails, including the principal, operation, policy, and cause of denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authorization operation that triggers the permission denied error. You can use this information to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the principal, such as RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An account administrator with the required permissions can decode this message to troubleshoot the cause of denial
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the permission denial cause, which distinguishes between implicit denial and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that causes the permission denied error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which corresponds to the requestId input parameter

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
